purpose: Current short-term ladder mainline independent of stock-promotion classifier; no numerical retraining or raw-score changes
comparison: Pareto dominance on relay_count, first_board_count and contiguous ladder_prefix_length; do not use weighted score, highest board alone, raw model score or next-day label
candidate_scope: Only active narratives from bounded verified original author text, matched to current provider business/event groups; generic labels excluded; unmatched groups preserved as unreviewed within checked-source scope

battery.definition: Existing fixed category or provider industry name contains 电池, union unique stock codes; no text-reason membership or hardcoded stock roster

missing_policy: Unknown category is not zero/nonmember; failed membership remains unknown; inadequate closing membership coverage or multiple incomparable eligible roots yields unknown/competition
